cases.description: Coordinator that delegates to independent operations must not be split solely because it coordinates multiple steps.
expectations: Does not fail SRP solely because multiple operations exist
Identifies transaction consistency boundary if present
Returns pass or uncertain, not fail

cases.description: Method that directly implements two policies with independent change drivers must fail SRP.
expectations: Identifies two distinct change drivers with requirement citations
Returns fail with evidence for each driver
States actual impact and remediation necessity separately

cases.description: Long method with many parameters must not fail SRP on structural metrics alone.
expectations: Does not fail SRP based on line count or parameter count alone
Requests or collects semantic evidence before deciding
Returns uncertain if semantic evidence is unavailable

cases.description: Single-implementation conditional must not trigger an OCP abstraction recommendation.
expectations: Does not recommend Strategy or interface without demonstrated variation
Returns not-applicable or pass for OCP
Records what future evidence would justify an extension point

cases.description: Target with no visible callers must not receive a definitive pass or fail when callers could change the decision.
expectations: Returns uncertain when hidden callers could alter the conclusion
Identifies what caller evidence is missing
